articles.title: The Inspiration Behind Lantana
articles.subtitle: An architectural reverie in handloom Chanderi silks and delicate pastel botanicals.
articles.excerpt: Lantana began on a sun-drenched morning in Jaipur, observing how delicate wildflowers bloom fearlessly between centuries-old sandstone arches. The collection translates that quiet strength into soft pastel Chanderi silhouettes with hand-scalloped lace trims.
articles.author: Jyoti Sharma
articles.content: Lantana began on a quiet morning during one of my sourcing walks through the sunlit alleys of Jaipur. Amidst the grandeur of weathered ochre walls and ancient jali screens, wild lantana florets were flourishing in defiance of arid soil.

articles.title: The Art of Indian Craftsmanship
articles.subtitle: Preserving generational textile heritage across Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh.
articles.excerpt: Every warp and weft spun on traditional pit looms carries centuries of collective memory. Inside our atelier, we work directly with master generational craftspeople to preserve techniques that industrial machines cannot replicate.
articles.author: Jyoti Sharma
articles.content: In an era of disposable fashion and hyper-speed production, true luxury is fundamentally about time: time spent waiting for natural monsoon riverbeds to dry, time spent grinding indigo cakes by hand, and time spent listening to the rhythmic wooden clatter of handloom shuttles.

articles.title: Styling the Modern Farshi Suit
articles.subtitle: How to wear sweeping heritage trousers from intimate sangeets to black-tie celebrations.
articles.excerpt: The Farshi suit is defined by dramatic architectural volume that sweeps the floor with royal gravitas. Discover three effortless ways to style our Pink Topaz and Pastel Yellow ensembles for contemporary celebrations.
articles.author: Atelier Styling Team
articles.content: The Farshi suit is among the most regal silhouettes in Indian sartorial history. Originating in royal Mughal and Awadhi courts, the word farshi literally translates to sweeping the floor.

articles.title: Inside the Boho Flare Affair
articles.subtitle: Fluid bohemian volume meets intricate hand-carved woodblock impressions.
articles.excerpt: Conceived as an ode to untamed spirit and effortless rhythm. Exploring the contrast between Design 01’s teardrop booti gathers and Design 02’s geometric mandala jaal in earthy moss olive.
articles.author: Jyoti Sharma
articles.content: When designing The Boho Flare Affair, we wanted to step away from traditional gala formality and explore an organic, free-spirited bohemian cadence.

articles.title: The Details Behind Every Stitch
articles.subtitle: A forensic macro look at hand-pressed block printing, natural mineral dyes, and French lace.
articles.excerpt: Take a magnifying glass to a Zamyaa garment and you will notice micro-variations in dye density—the unmistakable signature of the human hand at work.
articles.author: Atelier Textile Lab
articles.content: In the world of high fashion, true beauty reveals itself at macro distance. When you inspect a Zamyaa garment up close, you are looking at the work of skilled hands.
